items.title: Prove the secure installation-to-session lifecycle
items.acceptance_summary: An empty PostgreSQL installation provisions exactly one tenant/admin atomically with an explicit unlogged bootstrap secret, then authenticates and refreshes after restart and across two API instances without cross-tenant leakage.
items.next_action: Write and run the first RED tests for explicit-secret and durable installation-sentinel behavior.

items.title: Deliver an atomic encounter-to-receipt vertical slice
items.origin: PLAT-001, BILL-001/002, INV-001, CASH-001 and E2E-006/007 in the active August backlog
items.acceptance_summary: A scheduled or walk-in encounter reaches manual/cash settlement with clinical charge, inventory, ledger, cash, payment, audit and outbox consistency under rollback, replay, restart and two tenants.
items.next_action: Freeze a CVG-002B2b implementation-ready gate for signed inbound receipts and durable B1 settlement consumption; SPA remains separately gated B2c work.

items.title: Persist and dispatch a durable synthetic PIX attempt
items.origin: CVG-002B2 decomposition after worker/outbox, security, SPA/E2E, saga and TDD reviews
items.acceptance_summary: A tenant-scoped request persists exact-cents pending_dispatch state before any provider call; a dedicated lease/fenced dispatcher calls only an explicitly non-production idempotent provider outside UoW and survives concurrency, crash and restart without duplicate local or external intent.
items.next_action: No further B2a implementation is authorized; revalidate on trigger and advance only through the parent B2b gate.

items.title: Ingest signed synthetic PIX receipts and apply them durably through B1
items.origin: CVG-002B2 decomposition plus independent architecture, security, official-research and TDD reviews
items.acceptance_summary: A raw-body HMAC-authenticated synthetic callback durably persists an immutable tenant receipt and dedicated delivery before ACK; a fenced worker resolves a non-interactive service principal and invokes only the shared B1 core, which owns billing-first staging plus settlement before the same UoW completes delivery under replay, concurrency, restart and RLS without legacy settlement or secret leakage.
items.next_action: Add the operator-facing DLQ endpoint/runbook/alerts, define the multi-replica rate-limit policy and minimal authenticated-principal projection, then rerun B1/B2a/ingress/HTTP regressions and reassess VERIFIED while preserving 18/18 B1, 35/35 verifier/keyring, 77/77 focused, 11/11 ingress, 13/13 HTTP, 4/4 HTTP-to-PostgreSQL, 8/8 ACL, 5/5 service-principal and 54/54 worker evidence.

items.title: Replace structural scores with a behavioral verification spine
items.origin: AUD-013/014 and GATE-001/002 in the active August backlog
items.acceptance_summary: Every required behavior maps to current code, a rejecting test or observation, a revision-bound artifact and an honest current status; no existence-only score is release evidence.
items.next_action: Create the current requirement-to-evidence matrix from the frozen Quality Bar.

items.title: Close the eleven Vetus domain parity journeys
items.acceptance_summary: All eleven general and three clinical parity areas pass self-contained PostgreSQL-backed journeys with retries disabled, no skips, two tenants, restart, concurrency and failure injection where applicable.
items.next_action: Decompose each current parity blocker into one vertical capability journey.

items.title: Homologate external provider chains
items.origin: PAY-001, fiscal, laboratory, communications, storage and scanner gaps in the active August backlog
items.acceptance_summary: Payment, NFS-e, laboratory and communications providers have selected sandboxes, signed callbacks, replay/idempotency, retry/DLQ, reconciliation, outage behavior and operator evidence.
items.next_action: Obtain the human provider and sandbox decisions before implementation that depends on credentials or contracts.

items.title: Certify accessibility, performance, deployment and recovery
items.origin: G4/G5 and target-environment gaps in the active August backlog
items.acceptance_summary: WCAG 2.2 AA, performance SLOs, deploy/rollback, backup/restore, failover, observability and Game Day pass in the authorized target environment with durable evidence.
items.next_action: Reconcile the unsafe/stale runbooks and obtain target-environment, RTO/RPO and rollback authority.
